title: U.S. Census Bureau ACS Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) Acquisition Manifest
deidentification_statement: Official U.S. Census Bureau ACS PUMS data is public-use and de-identified under 13 U.S.C. Section 9. No personally identifiable information (PII) is included in PUMS microdata files or data dictionaries.
unresolved_behavioral_research_statement: This module provides a truthful ACS PUMS data acquisition and parsing substrate. No gameplay probabilities, behavioral rates, household formation rules, political affiliations, or simulation state mutations have been derived from this data. All such behavioral calibrations remain explicitly UNRESOLVED.
